description: Resume a paused email campaign. This sends real mail. Clears any pause reason and returns the campaign to the status it was paused from; if the cause still holds, the platform pauses it again (provider_refused after one more refused batch, balance or sender problems at the next batch). With resume_at more than a minute ahead the campaign stays paused and resumes at that time; resume_at is null otherwise, and a later pause_email_campaign cancels the plan. Only api, manual, and provider_refused pauses need this call; the others resume on their own once the cause clears. Errors: 409 SENDING_PAUSED (sending is suspended), 409 EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_TEST_REQUIRED (content changed during the pause: a human must send a test from the dashboard, then resume), 409 CONFLICT (draft, awaiting test or approval, ready, or completed), 400 for a past resume_at. An already running campaign returns 200 unchanged.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

resume_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time (Z or offset) to resume at. Omit to resume now. More than a minute in the past is rejected.

name: resume_email_campaign
